name: Daya Bay — reactor cores and experimental halls
notes: The three halls are drawn as derived points (not footprints): their positions come from multilateration, not from a survey or a tracing; accuracy_m on each hall covers the fit residual and the use of reactor-building centroids as proxies for the core centres.

summary.plain: The six reactor cores of the Daya Bay, Ling Ao and Ling Ao II plants and the three underground halls of the Daya Bay experiment, whose positions are trilaterated from the experiment's own published baselines.
summary.technical: Reactor-building footprints from OpenStreetMap (georeferenced); EH1–EH3 positions derived by least-squares multilateration from the six cores using the AD-to-core baselines of arXiv:1508.03943 Table 2 (survey uncertainty < 18 mm); overburdens from §2.2/Table 1 of the same paper.
